label: Tumpak Sewu activity day — breakfast, lunch varies by package
customer_note: Tumpak Sewu days always include breakfast. Lunch is included when the day continues with a long transfer (e.g., to Bromo area, 3–4 hours). On shorter days or when returning nearby, lunch is at own expense.

label: Lunch included on Ijen → Papuma long transfer day

customer_note: After the Ijen crater hike (returning to hotel ~08:00–09:00), guests have breakfast then continue toward Papuma/Jember (~4–5 hours). Lunch is included en route given the long transfer.
